item.title: Falcons fire coach Raheem Morris, GM Terry Fontenot hours after finishing 8-9 season
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons fired coach Raheem Morris and general manager Terry Fontenot on Sunday night, announcing the moves hours after the team completed its second straight 8-9 finish under Morris and eighth consecutive losing season. The post Falcons fire coach Raheem Morris, GM Terry Fontenot hours after finishing 8-9 season appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Thoughts from a Venezuelan on the US capture of Maduro and Flores
